## School Farm Safety Induction

Before starting any farm task, students must complete this induction check.

### I understand the following

- [ ] I know the safe way to enter and leave the farm area.
- [ ] I know the rules for wearing PPE.
- [ ] I understand the main hazards in this area.
- [ ] I know how to report a hazard, injury, or near miss.
- [ ] I know where the first aid kit and supervisor are located.
- [ ] I know how to work safely with animals, tools, and equipment.
- [ ] I know to stop work if I feel unsafe or unsure.

### Safety expectations

- Follow all instructions from the teacher or supervisor.
- Wear the correct PPE for the task.
- Keep pathways and work areas clear.
- Use tools safely and return them to storage.
- Keep a safe distance from animals.
- Keep chemicals stored and handled safely.
